subtitle: Lesson 29 · Joining Tables

eyebrow: Joining to a function, per row
code:
SELECT p.BusinessEntityID, ci.FirstName, ci.LastName
FROM Person.Person AS p
CROSS APPLY dbo.ufnGetContactInformation(p.BusinessEntityID)
    AS ci;
caption: For EVERY row in Person, the function runs again with THAT row's own BusinessEntityID.
